created_prompt: I currently work four days a week, with a limited time and budget, creating cooking content to 1.2m followers online. I would like to come up with a concrete plan so that in three years, I'll be able to grow enough online to be able to publish my own cookbook. What are the steps I should take in order to move from where I am now to a big enough audience in order to write a successful cookbook? Additionally, I would like to know if it's more practical and budget-friendly for me to self-publish or to take a traditional publishing route.
